# Musa the Giant (MTG) - Aurum Foundation Affiliate Site

The site helps South African and global users understand, join, and grow within the Aurum ecosystem using affiliate code EXTHT1.

- **Mission:** Onboarding 1,000 Millionaires through the Aurum Foundation ecosystem
